prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction-meme image of a ridiculously chubby golden-yellow cat laughing uncontrollably. Use a simple, softly shaded 3D cartoon style, like a squishy rubber toy. Give it an enormous rounded head merging into a pear-shaped body, a pale buttery belly, tiny legs, stubby paws, small triangular cat ears, and a short curved tail. Its head tips backward slightly; its eyes squeeze into tight upside-down U shapes, and its cheeks bunch up around an absurdly wide-open laughing mouth with a dark red interior and a large pink tongue. Add a tiny cat nose and short whiskers, but keep the face broad, goofy, and almost frog-like. Its belly thrusts forward and its little paws hover beside it as though its whole body is shaking with laughter. The expression should feel hilariously self-satisfied, unrestrained, and slightly obnoxious—an exaggerated “HAHAHAHA!” reaction. Center the character, filling most of the frame, against a plain muted background. Slightly low-resolution internet-meme appearance, soft lighting, no text, no watermark.
